import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df[
        (df['Quantity'].astype(int) == df['Quantity']) & 
        (df['Quantity'] >= 1) & 
        (df['Quantity'].notna()) & 
        (df['Price'] >= 0) & 
        (df['Price'].notna())
    ]
    df['Quantity'] = df['Quantity'].astype(int)
    return df

def answer(df):
    df['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'])
    df['Month'] = df['Date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
    monthly_revenue = df.groupby('Month')['Revenue'].sum().reset_index()
    return monthly_revenue.set_index('Month')['Revenue'].to_dict()
